name: altimate-code
description: Delegates dbt and warehouse work to altimate-code, a specialized CLI agent with 100+ purpose-built data tools (SQL analysis, column-level lineage, dbt build/test/run, warehouse profiling, FinOps, connectivity to Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, Postgres, MySQL, DuckDB).

interface.shortDescription: Delegate dbt + warehouse work to the altimate-code CLI agent
interface.longDescription: Routes data-engineering tasks — column-level lineage, cross-database validation, warehouse profiling, FinOps reporting, PII detection, dbt builds against real warehouses — to altimate-code, which already ships the specialised sub-skills internally. Ships two skills: `altimate-code` for delegation and `review` for dbt/SQL PR review with signed verdict envelopes. Use this plugin when you want Codex to hand a task to altimate-code rather than reimplement the workflow with native tools.
defaultPrompt: Compare row counts between prod and staging in Snowflake.
Run altimate-code review on this PR.
